never_overwrites: The existing processed/loso tree is left untouched. loso_v2 is a new directory.
assignment_rule: For fold i (1-indexed) over the sorted subject list S: test = S[i-1], val = S[i mod 11], train = the remaining 9.

FROZEN_INVARIANTS.I1_subject_disjoint: In every fold, train, val and test subject sets are pairwise disjoint.
FROZEN_INVARIANTS.I2_test_once: Each of the 11 subjects is the TEST subject in exactly one fold.
FROZEN_INVARIANTS.I3_val_once: Each of the 11 subjects is the VALIDATION subject in exactly one fold.
FROZEN_INVARIANTS.enforcement: All four are asserted by preflight BEFORE materialization and re-asserted by audit AFTER base-H5 generation. A failure aborts; nothing is silently degraded.

materialization_order: 2. Delete ONLY the files listed in docs/WSST4S_DELETION_MANIFEST.csv, by explicit path, to free space.
3. Generate base H5 (train/val/test per fold) into loso_v2.
4. AUDIT the base H5: subject inventory, record IDs, window counts, and SHA256 per file; re-assert I1-I4; confirm no two folds share a validation file hash.
5. Only after the audit passes, generate _wsst8s.h5 for all 11 folds.
6. Re-run B1 on folds 1/5/9 only, to establish the repaired baseline and confirm three distinct validation subjects.

post_materialization_audit.subject: per fold, the subject sets of train/val/test, checked against I1-I4
post_materialization_audit.record: record IDs per split; no record ID may appear in two splits of the same fold
post_materialization_audit.window: window counts per split; total windows across the three splits equals the source total for that fold
post_materialization_audit.hash: SHA256 of every generated file; the 11 validation files must have 11 DISTINCT hashes (the exact failure mode of the old split)

after_rebuild.immediate: Re-run B1 on folds 1/5/9 ONLY. Purpose is a repaired baseline and confirmation of three unique validation subjects.
after_rebuild.old_results: All conclusions from the old split remain blocked or protocol-invalid regardless of what the rebuild shows.

wsst4s_deletion.rationale: Superseded generated artifacts, fully rebuildable from source by scripts/precompute_wsst4s_mmecg.py from the base H5.
wsst4s_deletion.evidence_unused: 0 of 311 run-configs reference _wsst4s; 217 carry wsst_suffix=_wsst.h5 and 94 omit it.
wsst4s_deletion.caveat: Seven scripts still name _wsst4s as a selectable suffix and would fail at runtime if that data is requested; reproducing any run that used it requires regeneration first.
wsst4s_deletion.safety: Deletion is by explicit path from a SHA256 manifest. No recursive or glob deletion.
